title: 第3章 宝物的天堂第4章 卡片的名将
content_zh:
第三章 宝物的天堂
城主府的仓库！！！
秦岚随着新手美女指导走到了官府的后方，那里有一个巨大的房间，正中间的位置，有两个红色的礼箱，一个上面写着新手大礼包，一个却写着一级官府礼包。
新手大礼包！！秦岚突然想起，自己在穿越之前，好像改过礼包的设置。果然，他用激动的双手的东西竟然会自动归类堆放。流光四溢，绝对的流光四溢。礼包…
哈哈，秦岚先是仰天长笑，然后却又悲哀的摇头，他只有不到五十分钟的游戏时间了……这堆强大的宝物又有何用？？随手在了仓库浩瀚的宝物之中。
“恭喜您，金一万，神农锄一个，鲁班斧一个，开山锤一个，玄铁炉一个，鲁班残页一个，墨家残卷一个，珠宝匣一个，名将卡一张。”美女指导逐一的把所有东西报给秦岚知道，然后转身向外走，“现在您已经拥有了发展的基础资源，您可以在城主府直接使用它们。”
“用您手中的光束笔，点击大屏幕，请选择一块空地，在弹出的菜单中选择建造民房。”重新走回大屏幕下，她开始引导秦岚如何进行游戏。
原来是这样！！秦岚顿时了解，他握着手中的光笔，对准大屏幕上的空地按下顶端的按钮，果然，从光笔射出一束光线直直点在空地上之后，顿时弹出了一列菜单，显示着所有可以建造的建筑。
如同秦岚所知道的热血三国游戏一般，基本上所有的建筑都是灰色，只有民房和校场是点亮的，表示它们可以建造，秦岚选择了民房。一个新的城市，首先建造的肯定是民房，有了民房才有人口，才有人力去生产资源和做兵……
“民房建造中，请等待十秒……建造完毕。”民房在建造的时候，大屏幕上就显示出了它建造需要的时间。十秒？秦岚愕然，这才想起，自己修改了时间，建造速度是正常的十倍。
“恭喜您，民房建造完毕，您将获得资源奖励，粮食200，木材600，石料250，铁锭200，从现在开始有居民往城中搬迁了，您即将开始成为一个合格的城主，现在，我们来进行下一步，发展城池，离不开资源，做兵讨逆更是离不开大量资源，所以，您要随时掌握城池中资源的情报，请点击这里，查看您的剩余资源。”
用光笔点在了大屏幕左下角的资源情报按钮上，大屏幕的最上方顿时出现一副横条，上面显示着城中的所有情报。
粮食1010100，木材1010300，石料1010125，铁锭1010100，金钱1010000，人口1，税率10。哈，果然，当初设定初始资源是100万，这下方便了。
“您做的很好，现在我们开始学习如何建造资源矿产，请点击这里的外城按钮……”
秦岚却没有管她在讲什么，有资源有宝物，加上现在已经知道如何操作，剩下的已经难不倒他这个老手了。他飞快的在空地上建造民房，但是当他点第三个的时候，光幕上主动弹出一行字，您的建造序列已经做满，是否使用徭役令？选择是……徭役令吗？确实很珍贵，但是刚才他开了一千个……
徭役令，向百姓征发徭役，驱使大量劳力用于城池建设。使用后可增加3个建造队列，使城池可以同时建造5个建筑。效果持续72个小时，连续使用时间延长。
一级官府只能建造六个民房，秦岚很快就全部建造完毕并且给它们升级成二级民房，这才点击美女指导要求的外城按钮，大屏幕一切，出现在外城区，外城区目前只有十二个空地，是给玩家建造资源生产矿的。秦岚也不客气，十二个空地，一样资源矿先建造三个再说……升级，升级，升级！因为建造速度是十倍，所以，只花费了不到五分钟，十二个五级的资源矿已经矗立在了外城区。
“恭喜您，一级农田建造成功，您将获得资源奖励，粮食100，木材600，石料400，铁锭300……”
“恭喜您，一级伐木场建造成功，您将获得资源奖励，粮食200，木材200，石料500，铁锭600……”
“……”

秦岚已经完全无视新手指导，直接切回了内城，很干脆的用了宝物典民令。
典民令，吸纳大批失去土地的流民作为城池居民，增加人口数量为城池人口上限的20%，最少增加100人。如果城池人口已经超过上限，则不能使用。
官府升级到2级，需要城池的人口到达100，但是秦岚修改了住房的人口上限，所以典民令使用之后，人口迅速的抵达了3600！！在不用考虑资源限制的情况下，秦岚直接开始让官府升级，同时他开始建造市场，铁匠铺，校场，军营。三分钟之后，官府升级成功，开启了新建筑，接着秦岚开始建造工匠作坊，酒馆，书院。
酒馆建造完毕之后，就可以建造招贤馆，招贤馆建造成功之后才能招募和抓捕名将，同时它还能认命城池的城守，主将和军师。
“恭喜您……”美女指导在旁边，几乎就是不断的在重复这些话语，秦岚丝毫不理会，直接走出城主府，去了招贤馆。因为招贤馆的功能在城主府无法使用。
新建造起来的招贤馆也相当的巨大，大厅中一样有一道光幕，上面会显示城市里将领的属性和职位，以及招贤馆的各种操作功能。
秦岚只是抬头看了一眼，顿时就呆住了……因为本来应该没有任何资料的将领栏中，他的大名赫赫在目。
秦岚，等级1，统率10，体力8/10，精力10/10，内政10，勇武10，智谋10，魅力10，运气10，忠诚－－，职位城守，官职无，爵位无。
我怎么会成为三国其中的一员？？而且是这么垃圾的属性？？简直跟热血三国中的汉灵帝的属性相提并论……等等，难道这个显示的是，就是我这个身体的属性？？而且这样说来，我是不是可以跟其它将领一样通过建造东西和出兵征讨来获得经验并且升级？？
秦岚立刻点开了查看自己的属性，果然，在展开的页面中，自己头像下，很清晰的标注着，经验98/100。
这是！！马上就要升级了啊！
content_en:
Chapter 3 The Paradise of Treasures
The warehouse of the city lord's palace! ! !
Qin Lan followed the novice beauty guide to the back of the official house. There was a huge room there. In the middle, there were two red gift boxes. One had a novice gift package written on it, and the other had a first-level official official gift package written on it.
Big gift package for newbies! ! Qin Lan suddenly remembered that he seemed to have changed the settings of the gift package before traveling through time. Sure enough, the things he held with his excited hands were automatically sorted and stacked. Overflowing with light, absolutely overflowing with light. Gift pack…
Haha, Qin Lan first smiled up at the sky, and then shook his head sadly. He only had less than fifty minutes of game time... What's the use of these powerful treasures? ? It was casually among the vast treasures in the warehouse.
"Congratulations, you have ten thousand gold, a Shennong hoe, a Luban axe, a mountain hammer, a black iron furnace, a Luban fragment, a Mohist fragment, a jewelry box, and a famous general card." The beautiful guide reported everything to Qin Lan one by one, then turned and walked out, "Now that you have the basic resources for development, you can use them directly in the City Lord's Mansion."
"Use the beam pen in your hand, click on the big screen, please select an open space, and choose to build a private house in the pop-up menu." She walked back to the big screen and began to guide Qin Lan on how to play the game.
So that’s it! ! Qin Lan understood immediately. He held the light pen in his hand, pointed it at the open space on the big screen, and pressed the button at the top. Sure enough, after a beam of light was emitted from the light pen and pointed directly at the open space, a list of menus popped up, showing all the buildings that could be built.
Just like the Three Kingdoms game that Qin Lan knew, basically all the buildings were gray, and only private houses and school fields were lit, indicating that they could be built. Qin Lan chose private houses. In a new city, the first thing to be built must be private houses. Only with private houses can there be a population and manpower to produce resources and build troops...
"The private house is under construction, please wait ten seconds...the construction is completed." When the private house is being built, the time it takes to build is displayed on the big screen. Ten seconds? Qin Lan was stunned and then remembered that he had modified the time and the construction speed was ten times faster than normal.
"Congratulations, the construction of the private house is completed. You will receive resource rewards, 200 grain, 600 wood, 250 stone, and 200 iron ingots. From now on, residents will move to the city. You are about to become a qualified city lord. Now, let's take the next step. Developing the city is inseparable from resources, and fighting against rebellion requires a large amount of resources. Therefore, you must always have information about the resources in the city. Please click here to view your remaining resources."
Use the light pen to click on the resource information button in the lower left corner of the big screen. A horizontal bar suddenly appeared at the top of the big screen, displaying all the information in the city.
Food 1010100, wood 1010300, stone 1010125, iron ingot 1010100, money 1010000, population 1, tax rate 10. Ha, sure enough, the initial resource was set to 1 million, which is convenient now.
"You did a good job, now we start to learn how to build resource minerals, please click the outer city button here..."
Qin Lan didn't care what she was talking about. He had resources and treasures, and now knew how to operate it. The rest was no longer difficult for him, a veteran. He quickly built houses on the open space, but when he clicked on the third one, a message popped up on the light screen. Your construction sequence has been completed. Do you want to use the corvee order? Is the choice...a corvee order? It is indeed very precious, but he just opened a thousand...
The corvée order levied corvées from the people and mobilized a large amount of labor for city construction. After use, 3 construction queues can be added, allowing the city to build 5 buildings at the same time. The effect lasts for 72 hours with continuous useextend.
The first-level government can only build six private houses. Qin Lan quickly completed all the construction and upgraded them to second-level private houses. Then he clicked the outer city button requested by the beauty guide, and everything on the big screen appeared in the outer city. There are currently only twelve open spaces in the outer city, which are used for players to build resource production mines. Qin Lan is not polite. There are twelve open spaces, and three of the same resource mines will be built first and then... upgrade, upgrade, upgrade! Because the construction speed was ten times faster, it only took less than five minutes for twelve level five resource mines to be erected in the outer city.
"Congratulations, the first-level farmland has been successfully constructed. You will receive resource rewards, 100 grain, 600 wood, 400 stone, 300 iron ingots..."
"Congratulations, the first-level lumberyard has been successfully constructed. You will receive resource rewards, 200 grain, 200 wood, 500 stone, 600 iron ingots..."
"..."
Qin Lan had completely ignored the novice instructions, switched directly back to the inner city, and simply used the treasure code civil order.
The Dianmin Order absorbs a large number of landless refugees as city residents and increases the population by 20% of the city's population limit, with a minimum increase of 100 people. If the city population has exceeded the upper limit, it cannot be used.
To upgrade the government to level 2, the city's population needs to reach 100, but Qin Lan modified the upper population limit for housing, so after the dianmin order was used, the population quickly reached 3,600! ! Without having to consider resource constraints, Qin Lan directly began to upgrade the government. At the same time, he began to build markets, blacksmith shops, schools, and military camps. Three minutes later, the government was successfully upgraded and new buildings were opened. Then Qin Lan began to build craftsmen's workshops, taverns, and academies.
After the tavern is built, you can build a recruitment hall. Only after the recruitment hall is successfully built can you recruit and capture famous generals. At the same time, it can also accept the city's guards, generals and military advisors.
"Congratulations..." The beautiful instructor was beside her, repeating these words almost constantly. Qin Lan ignored her at all and walked directly out of the City Lord's Mansion and went to the Talent Recruitment Hall. Because the functions of the Recruitment Hall cannot be used in the City Lord's Mansion.
The newly built recruitment hall is also quite huge. There is also a light curtain in the hall, which will display the attributes and positions of the generals in the city, as well as the various operating functions of the recruitment hall.
Qin Lan just raised his head and glanced, and was stunned... because his name was prominently visible in the column of generals that should have contained no information.
Qin Lan, level 1, command 10, physical strength 8/10, energy 10/10, internal affairs 10, bravery 10, resourcefulness 10, charm 10, luck 10, loyalty -, position city guard, no official position, no title.
How could I become one of the Three Kingdoms? ? And it’s such a rubbish attribute? ? It is almost comparable to the attributes of Han Ling Emperor in Three Kingdoms... Wait, does this show the attributes of my body? ? And in this case, can I gain experience and level up by building things and sending troops to conquer like other generals? ?
Qin Lan immediately clicked on it to check his own attributes. Sure enough, on the expanded page, under his avatar, it was clearly marked that the experience was 98/100.
This is! ! It will be upgraded soon!
